sourceQuote: Program Description Entrance Exam and Admission For Undergraduates The applicants, whose documents are approved by the International Student Exchange Office of the International Education, are required to attend the entrance exam given by BIPT.
targetQuote: 项目说明 入学考试与本科招生 申请人的材料经北京邮电大学国际教育学院国际学生交流办公室审核通过后，须参加北京邮电大学组织的入学考试。
